prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Discover Your Desktop Companion", "Swipe through the story of how your pet lives right on your desktop desktop companion journey."]
1: ["Keep Your Desktop Pet Safe", "Sign in on the next step to ensure your companion's traits, name, and history are backed up securely."]
2: ["Choose Your Desktop Friend", "Browse through available pet companions to find your perfect desk partner."]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Workspace", "Verifying screen bounds and background layer so your pet renders cleanly on top of windows.", "Screen resolution check, Window layering check, Transparency test"]
4: ["Right-Click Your Pet Anytime to Access Desktop Controls", "Use the right-click menu or tray icon to adjust pet visibility, volume, and desktop behaviors."]
5: ["Select whether to pick from pre-made pet companions or generate a custom creation from your own photos."]
6: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Link your account to restore your desktop pet anytime and prevent pet data resets across reloads."]
7: ["For best custom rendering results, use clear photos with balanced lighting and a single focused subject."]
8: ["Creating Your Companion Desktop Asset", "Your companion is being assembled and calibrated for desktop display."]
9: ["Welcome Your New Pet to the Desktop", "Your pet is now active on your screen. Learn how to interact, minimize, or adjust settings at any time."]
